title: etcd3gw Python Client — v3 gRPC-gateway API and release 2.7.0
version: etcd3gw 2.7.0; PyPI release 2026-06-09; source mirror https://github.com/openstack/etcd3gw and canonical source https://opendev.org/openstack/etcd3gw/; accessed 2026-11-26.
locator: Python HTTP client for etcd v3 gRPC-gateway. API exposes Range, Txn, Lease Grant/KeepAlive/Revoke and Watch event iteration. Current watch stream parser suppresses created responses and dispatches events rather than returning the complete WatchResponse envelope required for compact-revision, cancel and fragment cursor handling.
notes: Used as a third-party OpenStack-maintained Python client, pinned to 2.7.0 for the optional integration extra. This project maps Range/Txn/Lease only and intentionally does not advertise normalized Watch. No claims of etcd-io official Python SDK status.
